name: Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme - Unemployed Young Professional Sportsperson
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Tripura. - The applicant should be a young sportsperson. - The applicant should be an experienced professional. - The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 40 years (a relaxation of 5 years in the upper age limit for ST/SC candidates).
